<thought>After checking the available functional group names, I will search the template catalog using the functional groups that are broken (ketones and C‑C double bonds) and the functional group that is formed (ether oxygens). This should retrieve a template for the intramolecular Michael cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. Once a template is found, I will obtain its SMARTS, map the reaction to get a mapped reaction SMILES, and return the required JSON.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
